## Change

Explain the problem, the trigger and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue.

## Validation

List the relevant checks you actually ran and their results. For interface changes, include a screenshot; for data changes, include years, coverage, publisher, source links and reuse conditions.

## Review notes

Explain any remaining limitation, migration or follow-up needed to assess this change. Keep official data, fictional demo data and private account information clearly identified.
